reason: Conversation 1 reached the right diagnosis (iced evaporator from a defrost-system fault), guided a safe 24h manual defrost with a 'no sharp tools' warning, used the recurrence after 5 days as confirmation, and correctly escalated to an engineer because the rear-panel work and live testing are not owner-safe.
